caption: Weinreb clone-trajectory embedding. Each point represents one of 569 retained LARRY clones, colored by its ChronoClone metaclone (20 groups). The original locked UMAP coordinates summarize normalized clone-by-time-by-working-state profiles across Days 2, 4, and 6. This retrospective reference-space visualization is distinct from the single-cell landscape and is not independent evidence of cluster recovery.

Singh WT clone-trajectory embedding. Each point represents one of 1,516 resolved clonal families, colored by its fixed WT-reference metaclone (17 groups). The preserved embedding summarizes WT compositions in seven cell categories at Days 7, 14, and 27, with HSPCs represented as one category. No mutant data are required to place these reference points. The coordinates are independent of the Weinreb embedding and cannot be compared across datasets.
